body: 新增 2 筆臨床試驗、1 家在研療法業者、1 篇文獻，是本站近期補收最多的一天。（1）先前漏收的 Ph2：思捷優達 Dasher Neuroscience（台灣）的 YA-101（NCT06848231）——口服D-胺基酸氧化酶（DAAO）抑制劑，公司自述機轉為抑制發炎細胞激素、降低神經發炎並促進神經可塑性。全球多中心、雙盲、安慰劑對照、劑量遞增；收 30 歲以上依 MDS 準則確診的 MSA 病人，MSA-P 與 MSA-C 皆收；主要終點為不良事件發生率與嚴重度，次要終點含藥物動力學、UMSARS 與 10 公尺步行測試；站點為美國 6 站、日本 1 站、台灣 2 站，登錄狀態已轉為收案完成、雙盲進行中（狀態查核日 2026-08）。⚠️ 收案人數兩個公開來源不一致：公司 2026-07-28 新聞稿稱完成 90 人，CT.gov 登錄預計收案 75 人，本站兩者並列、不擇一採信。法規面依公司公開資料載有 FDA 快速通道資格與美／日／歐盟孤兒藥資格，公開來源未載核予日期，故不填年份。公司稱 topline 預計 2027 Q1，登錄主要完成日 2027-06-30；目前無任何療效數據公開讀出。同步在「在研療法全景」新增該筆（category：dmt）。（2）新登錄的極早期試驗：上海瑞金醫院的 α-Syn H21 單株抗體（NCT07774585），人源化抗體、設計上選擇性結合病理性 α-synuclein 聚集體，靜脈輸注每 4 週一次共 3 劑、追蹤 12 週，預計 2026-09-15 起始。⚠️ n＝3、單一中心、研究者發起的探索性研究，樣本數不足以推論療效，登錄亦未載明開發廠商。（3）文獻：佛羅里達大學 Fixel 研究所與順天堂、北里、印度 AIIMS 合作，於 Journal of Parkinson's Disease 刊出非典型帕金森症候群復健的範疇綜述——依 PRISMA-ScR 檢索至 2025 年 5 月，納入 60 篇（其中 MSA 20 篇），結論為復健一致地安全可行，步態平衡訓練、發聲吞嚥治療與多模式方案有短期效益，但證據等級僅 AAN Class III–IV，且缺乏標準化療效指標。⚠️ 範疇綜述未做偏誤風險評估、未合併效果量，且結論涵蓋四種疾病、非 MSA 專屬。當日掃描結果：CT.gov MSA 查詢窗內其餘更新（Biogen salanersen、Entrada 兩筆 ENTR-601、Dyne DYNE-251、Roche risdiplam、AstraZeneca AZD9750）經逐筆確認適應症為 SMA、DMD 或前列腺癌，均屬「atrophy」字面誤中，予以排除；Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Ono ONO-2808、Teva TEV-56286 近 7 天無新事實。

en.body: Two clinical trials, one investigational-therapy developer and one paper added — the largest single day of backfill on this site in recent weeks. (1) A previously missed Ph2: YA-101 from Dasher Neuroscience (Taiwan) (NCT06848231) — an oral D-amino acid oxidase (DAAO) inhibitor that the company describes as inhibiting inflammatory cytokines, reducing neuroinflammation and enhancing neuroplasticity. The trial is global, multi-centre, double-blind, placebo-controlled and dose-escalating; it enrols MSA patients aged 30 and over diagnosed per MDS criteria, covering both MSA-P and MSA-C; the primary endpoint is the incidence and severity of adverse events, with pharmacokinetics, UMSARS and the 10-Metre Walk Test among the secondary endpoints; sites are in the United States (6), Japan (1) and Taiwan (2), and the registration now shows enrolment complete with the double-blind phase ongoing (status verified 2026-08). ⚠️ The two public sources disagree on enrolment: the company's 2026-07-28 press release states 90 completed, while the CT.gov registration lists a target of 75 — this site reports both rather than choosing between them. Company materials cite FDA Fast Track designation and orphan drug designation in the US, Japan and the EU; the public sources give no grant dates, so no years are stated. The company expects topline data in Q1 2027 and the registered primary completion date is 2027-06-30; no efficacy data have been read out publicly. A matching entry was added to the therapy landscape (category: dmt). (2) A newly registered, very early trial: the α-Syn H21 monoclonal antibody at Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai (NCT07774585), a humanised antibody designed to bind selectively to pathological alpha-synuclein aggregates, given by intravenous infusion every 4 weeks for 3 doses with 12 weeks of follow-up and a planned start of 2026-09-15. ⚠️ With n = 3, a single centre and an investigator-initiated exploratory design, it is far too small to support efficacy inference, and the registration names no developer. (3) Paper: the Fixel Institute at the University of Florida, with Juntendo, Kitasato and AIIMS India, published a scoping review of rehabilitation in atypical parkinsonian syndromes in the Journal of Parkinson's Disease — searching to May 2025 under PRISMA-ScR and including 60 studies (20 of them in MSA). It concludes that rehabilitation is consistently safe and feasible and that gait and balance training, voice and swallowing therapy and multimodal programmes show short-term benefits, but at an evidence level of only AAN Class III–IV and with no standardised outcome measures. ⚠️ A scoping review performs no risk-of-bias assessment and pools no effect sizes, and its conclusions span four disorders rather than being MSA-specific. Scan coverage today: the other CT.gov records updated inside the window (Biogen's salanersen, two Entrada ENTR-601 trials, Dyne's DYNE-251, Roche's risdiplam and AstraZeneca's AZD9750) were each checked and excluded as SMA, DMD or prostate cancer — literal 'atrophy' matches rather than MSA. Alterity's ATH434, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Ono's ONO-2808 and Teva's TEV-56286 produced no new facts within the past 7 days.

body: 文獻雷達新增 1 篇。作法更正：前兩日的掃描兩度命中 Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging 一篇評介結構性 MRI 體積測量鑑別 PSP／PD／MSA 的社論（PubMed 42596062），並以「評論性短文、無原始數據」為由排除——排除社論本身仍屬正確，但當時未回頭去找它評介的原始論文。今日補上該原始論文：北京協和醫院與北京天壇醫院團隊的 PDSVI（parkinsonism volumetric index），一個全自動、不依賴特定軟體的腦容積指標，公式為（橋腦體積 × 第三腦室體積）/（中腦體積 × 視丘體積）× 10，用以取代現行需人工在特定切面測量、費時且受判讀者影響的 2D 指標。世代為 480 名病人（PD 246、PSP 108、MSA-C 63、MSA-P 63）加 252 名健康對照，隨機分訓練組 320／內部驗證組 160。內部驗證：區辨 PSP 與非 PSP AUC 0.897，對 PD 0.873、對 MSA-P 0.950、對 MSA-C 0.939、對健康對照 0.909，與人工測量的 MRPI 相當。⚠️ 限制須一併讀：單一國家、以中國人族群為主，僅內部驗證、無獨立外部世代；PDSVI 是為偵測 PSP 而設計，MSA 在此是對照組而非目標診斷，故高 AUC 反映的是把 MSA 排除在 PSP 之外的能力，不代表能區分 MSA-P 與 MSA-C，也不代表能把 MSA 與 PD 分開。原始論文出版日為 2026/07/01、落在 7 天窗外，之所以仍予收錄，是因為它是本站漏收的實質內容、且由窗內社論帶出；此一判斷在此記錄備查。PubMed 窗內其餘 6 筆均已在檔。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢近 7 天內無新試驗、亦無狀態變動：窗內更新者為 Entrada 兩筆 DMD 試驗、Grünenthal GRT6019（DMD）與 AstraZeneca AZD9750（前列腺癌），均屬「atrophy」字面誤中或非 MSA 適應症，逐筆確認適應症後排除。在研療法新聞掃描（Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Ono ONO-2808）未見近 7 天內的新事實，檢索命中者均為既有已記錄事件之轉載。

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar. A correction of method: the scans of the past two days twice hit an editorial in the Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (PubMed 42596062) reviewing structural MRI volumetry for distinguishing PSP, PD and MSA, and excluded it as a short commentary carrying no primary data. Excluding the editorial was right, but no one went back to find the original paper it was reviewing. That paper is added today: the PDSVI (parkinsonism volumetric index) from Peking Union Medical College Hospital and Beijing Tiantan Hospital, a fully automated, software-independent brain volumetry metric calculated as (pons volume × third ventricle volume) / (midbrain volume × thalamus volume) × 10, intended to replace the current 2D metrics, which must be measured manually on specific planes and are both laborious and observer-dependent. The cohort was 480 patients (246 PD, 108 PSP, 63 MSA-C, 63 MSA-P) plus 252 healthy controls, randomised into a training set of 320 and an internal validation set of 160. In internal validation it separated PSP from non-PSP with an AUC of 0.897, and from PD at 0.873, MSA-P at 0.950, MSA-C at 0.939 and healthy controls at 0.909 — comparable to the manually measured MRPI. ⚠️ The limitations belong with the figures: a single country and a predominantly Chinese population, with internal validation only and no independent external cohort. The PDSVI was designed to detect PSP, and MSA serves here as a comparator rather than the target diagnosis, so the high AUCs reflect the ability to exclude MSA from PSP; they do not indicate that MSA-P can be separated from MSA-C, nor that MSA can be separated from PD. The original paper was published on 2026/07/01, outside the 7-day window; it is recorded nonetheless because it is substantive content this site had missed and because the editorial that surfaced it fell inside the window — that judgement is noted here for the record. The other six PubMed hits in the window were already on file. Today's CT.gov query returned no new MSA trials and no status changes within the past 7 days: the records updated in the window were two Entrada DMD trials, Grünenthal's GRT6019 (DMD) and AstraZeneca's AZD9750 (prostate cancer), all either literal 'atrophy' matches or non-MSA indications and excluded after checking each. The sweep of investigational-therapy news (Alterity's ATH434, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Ono's ONO-2808) found no new facts within the past 7 days — every hit restated an event already on record.

body: 文獻雷達新增 1 篇。多倫多大學 Tanz 神經退化疾病研究中心與大學健康網絡團隊發表於 Acta Neuropathologica，主題為路易體疾病（LBD）與 MSA 死後皮膚檢體中 α-突觸核蛋白種子活性（seeding）的差異。⚠️ 本筆刻意只記錄「已發表、主題為何」：該文為 Letter 體裁，PubMed 未收錄摘要、出版社端全文為付費牆，本平台無法查證樣本數、檢測平台與判別準確度，因此不轉述任何未經查證的結果數字。收錄理由在於方向而非結論——皮膚是活體可取得的組織，而 MSA 與 LBD（含帕金森病、路易體失智症）的生前鑑別診斷是本領域長期未解的實務問題：現行皮膚種子擴增試驗多半只能判定「有無 α-突觸核蛋白病理」，能否進一步分辨「是哪一種」尚未定案。本篇與 08/14 收錄的兩篇株型研究（PubMed 42600994、42601815）屬同一條研究線，作者群同樣出自 Tanz 中心（與 42601815 為不同實驗室）。在取得全文之前，不應假定本文已證實皮膚檢測可用於鑑別診斷，亦不應假定其適用於活體。另 PubMed 窗內第二筆命中為 Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging 之結構性 MRI 體積測量鑑別 PSP／PD／MSA 編輯評論，即昨日已評估並排除的同一篇（評論性短文、無原始數據），維持不予收錄。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢近 7 天內無新試驗、亦無狀態變動：窗內更新者為 Entrada 兩筆 DMD 試驗、Grünenthal GRT6019（DMD）、Biogen salanersen 與 Dyne DYNE-251、AstraZeneca AZD9750（前列腺癌），以及 Kuopio 大學醫院一筆神經退化疾病觀察性研究，均屬「atrophy」字面誤中或非 MSA 適應症，逐筆確認後排除。

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar. From the Tanz Centre for Research in Neurodegenerative Disease at the University of Toronto and the University Health Network, in Acta Neuropathologica, on differences in α-synuclein seeding activity between post-mortem skin in Lewy body disease (LBD) and in MSA. ⚠️ This entry deliberately records only that the paper exists and what it is about: it is a Letter, PubMed carries no abstract, and the publisher's full text is paywalled, so the sample sizes, assay platform and discriminative accuracy could not be verified — and no result is being paraphrased unverified. It is included for its direction rather than its conclusion: skin is a tissue obtainable from living patients, and telling MSA from LBD (Parkinson's disease and dementia with Lewy bodies included) during life remains an unsolved practical problem in this field — existing skin seed-amplification assays can generally establish whether α-synuclein pathology is present, while whether they can establish which disease is unsettled. The paper belongs to the same line of work as the two strain papers recorded on 14 August (PubMed 42600994 and 42601815), and its authors are likewise from the Tanz Centre, in a different laboratory from 42601815. Until the full text is obtained, it should not be assumed that this establishes skin testing as a differential diagnostic, nor that it applies in living patients. The second PubMed hit in the window, an editorial in the Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging on structural MRI volumetry for distinguishing PSP, PD and MSA, is the same one assessed and excluded yesterday — a short commentary carrying no primary data — and remains excluded. Today's CT.gov query returned no new MSA trials and no status changes within the past 7 days: the records updated in the window were two Entrada DMD trials, Grünenthal's GRT6019 (DMD), Biogen's salanersen and Dyne's DYNE-251, AstraZeneca's AZD9750 (prostate cancer), and one observational neurodegenerative-disease study from Kuopio University Hospital — all either literal 'atrophy' matches or non-MSA indications, excluded after checking each.

body: 文獻雷達新增 2 篇，兩篇同日發表、同談 α-突觸核蛋白株型（strain），且方向互補。（1）哥本哈根大學醫院、羅斯基勒大學與法國 Institut François Jacob 團隊發表於 Neurobiology of Disease：以蛋白質錯誤摺疊循環放大從 MSA 與帕金森病腦組織擴增 α-突觸核蛋白纖維，接種至神經元培養與小鼠比較——MSA 來源纖維誘發較多磷酸化 α-突觸核蛋白病理，且誘發的寡突膠細胞病理顯著多於 PD 來源材料，支持兩病纖維具不同生物特性。這與 MSA 病理上以寡突膠細胞內膠質細胞質包涵體為定義特徵相符。屬動物與細胞實驗、非病人研究，「較強效」指實驗系統中的接種能力，不可外推為病程速度或治療反應；作者群含 H. Lundbeck A/S 四名任職者（該公司 amlenetug 為本站追蹤之 MSA 在研藥物，機制正是針對細胞外 α-突觸核蛋白傳播），一併揭露。（2）多倫多大學 Tanz 中心、麻省總醫院與烏普薩拉大學團隊發表於 Brain Pathology：檢驗 MSA 兩個臨床亞型小腦型（MSA-C）與帕金森型（MSA-P）是否屬不同株型，以有限蛋白酶解與構形穩定性測定做生化指紋、並在基因轉殖小鼠做接種傳播比較，結果均未能區分兩者，作者解讀為源自同一株型在不同腦區成形。兩篇合看方向一致而非矛盾——株型差異存在於 MSA 與 PD 之間，不存在於 MSA 內部；若成立，這與現行 MSA 試驗多將兩亞型合併收案的作法前提相符。惟第二篇是「未發現差異」的陰性結果，陰性不等於證明相同，也可能是方法分辨力不足，該研究亦未報告樣本數是否足以排除中小幅度差異。另有一則 Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging 關於結構性 MRI 體積測量鑑別 PSP／PD／MSA 的編輯評論，因屬對他人研究的評論性短文、無原始數據，經評估不予收錄。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢近 7 天內無新試驗、亦無狀態變動：窗內更新的 MSA 相關筆為 Teva TEV-56286 延伸試驗（NCT07197866，已在紀錄內），其餘 08/11–08/13 更新者為 DMD、SMA 與前列腺癌試驗，屬「atrophy」字面誤中，逐筆確認適應症後排除。

en.body: Two papers added to the literature radar — published the same day, both on α-synuclein strains, and complementary in what they find. (1) From Copenhagen University Hospital, Roskilde University and the Institut François Jacob in France, in Neurobiology of Disease: α-synuclein fibrils were amplified from MSA and Parkinson's disease brain by protein misfolding cyclic amplification and inoculated into neuronal cultures and mice. MSA-derived fibrils induced more phosphorylated α-synuclein pathology, and significantly more oligodendroglial pathology than PD-derived material, supporting distinct biological properties for the fibrils of the two diseases — consistent with MSA being defined pathologically by the glial cytoplasmic inclusion within oligodendrocytes. This is animal and cell work rather than a patient study; "more potent" refers to seeding capacity in an experimental system and cannot be extrapolated to rate of progression or treatment response. Four authors are employees of H. Lundbeck A/S, whose amlenetug is one of the investigational MSA agents tracked here and whose mechanism targets the spread of extracellular α-synuclein — disclosed accordingly. (2) From the Tanz Centre at the University of Toronto with Massachusetts General Hospital and Uppsala University, in Brain Pathology: a test of whether the two clinical subtypes, cerebellar (MSA-C) and parkinsonian (MSA-P), carry distinct strains, using limited proteolysis and a conformational stability assay for biochemical fingerprinting alongside seeding and progression comparisons in transgenic mice. Neither approach distinguished the two, which the authors read as one strain forming in different brain regions. Together the two papers point the same way rather than conflicting — strain differences lie between MSA and PD, not within MSA — and if that holds it matches the premise behind the prevailing practice of enrolling both subtypes into a single MSA trial. The second paper is nonetheless a negative result: failing to find a difference is not proof of sameness, the methods may lack the resolution for subtler differences, and the study does not report whether the sample could exclude a small or moderate one. A third hit, an editorial in the Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging on structural MRI volumetry for distinguishing PSP, PD and MSA, was considered and excluded as a short commentary on someone else's study carrying no primary data. Today's CT.gov query returned no new MSA trials and no status changes within the past 7 days: the one MSA-related record updated in the window was Teva's TEV-56286 extension study (NCT07197866), already on the platform, while the 11–13 August updates were DMD, SMA and prostate cancer trials — literal 'atrophy' matches, excluded after checking the indication on each.

body: 文獻雷達新增 2 篇、領域焦點新增 1 則。（1）范德堡大學醫學中心與 CND Life Sciences 團隊發表於 Clinical Autonomic Research 的 12 個月縱貫研究：17 名早期 MSA 病人的皮膚切片 α-突觸核蛋白沉積自基線至 12 個月上升，並與姿勢性低血壓與自律神經症狀相關，作者主張皮膚切片可作為侵入性較低的診斷輔助、病程追蹤與試驗分層工具。n=17 且無疾病對照組（未與帕金森病等其他突觸核蛋白病變比較），故無法說明鑑別診斷特異度；作者群含 Alterity Therapeutics 兩名任職者，一併揭露。收錄理由是它與本站追蹤的 α-突觸核蛋白 PET 示蹤劑（MODAG、Synusight）指向同一個缺口——MSA 確診迄今仍須死後病理，而皮膚切片的技術門檻與成本遠低於 PET。（2）土耳其兩校團隊發表於 Diagnostics 的病例對照研究：30 對 30 測定 11 種血清微量元素，MSA 組鋁、銅較高，鐵、鋅較低，自建之金屬負荷指數經年齡性別校正後仍相關。作者自陳為探索性、需在疾病對照與多中心世代驗證——對照組非其他神經退化疾病是關鍵缺口，且複合指數在自身資料上建構會高估分辨力；另需留意本研究量的是血清鐵並發現偏低，與「腦內特定區域鐵沉積」的機轉假說不是同一件事。（3）領域焦點：Alterity ATH434 於 2026/08/12 取得美國專利商標局新核准之物質組成專利（甲磺酸鹽特定結晶型＋治療方法），公司稱保護期延長至至少 2045 年，且該結晶型即 Ph2 所用、將用於規劃中的 Ph3；此為專利事項、非臨床或法規進展，新聞稿未載專利號。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢回傳之相關試驗（Teva TEV-56286 主試驗與延伸、Lundbeck amlenetug MASCOT、Alterity ATH434 開放標籤延伸、MODAG 造影、Synusight SST001、AskBio 前置研究）全部已在平台紀錄內、狀態無變動；其餘為 DMD、SMA、肌少症等「atrophy」字面誤中，逐筆確認適應症後排除。

en.body: Two papers added to the literature radar and one item to the field highlights. (1) A 12-month longitudinal study from Vanderbilt University Medical Center and CND Life Sciences in Clinical Autonomic Research: in 17 people with early-stage MSA, α-synuclein deposition on skin biopsy increased from baseline to 12 months and correlated with orthostatic hypotension and autonomic symptoms, leading the authors to propose skin biopsy as a minimally invasive aid to diagnosis, progression monitoring and trial stratification. With n=17 and no disease-control arm — no comparison against Parkinson's disease or other synucleinopathies — it cannot speak to specificity for differential diagnosis; two authors are employees of Alterity Therapeutics, disclosed here. It is recorded because it addresses the same gap as the α-synuclein PET tracers this site tracks (MODAG, Synusight): definitive diagnosis of MSA still requires post-mortem pathology, and skin biopsy is far cheaper and technically simpler than PET. (2) A case-control study from two Turkish universities in Diagnostics: eleven serum trace elements measured in 30 patients versus 30 controls, with higher aluminium and copper and lower iron and zinc in MSA, and a composite Metal Burden Index that remained associated after adjustment for age and sex. The authors call the work exploratory and state it needs validation in disease-control and multicentre cohorts — the absence of a neurodegenerative comparison group is the decisive gap, and an index derived and evaluated on the same data will overstate its separating power. Note too that this study measures serum iron and finds it low, which is not the same quantity as the regional brain iron deposition that the mechanistic hypothesis concerns. (3) Field highlight: on 12 August 2026 Alterity's ATH434 was granted a new US composition-of-matter patent (a specific crystalline form of the mesylate salt, plus methods of treatment), which the company says extends protection to at least 2045, the form being the one used in Ph2 and intended for the planned Ph3. This is an intellectual-property matter rather than clinical or regulatory progress, and the release gives no patent number. Every MSA-related trial returned by today's CT.gov query (Teva's TEV-56286 main and extension studies, Lundbeck's amlenetug MASCOT, Alterity's ATH434 open-label extension, the MODAG imaging study, Synusight's SST001 and the AskBio pre-gene-therapy study) was already on the platform with no change of status; the remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches in DMD, SMA and sarcopenia, excluded after checking the indication on each record.

body: 文獻雷達新增 1 篇：Clinical Neuropathology 一則年輕發病帕金森症候群的臨床病理不一致個案——病人生前被診斷為神經傳導物質合成障礙（一類多屬可治療的遺傳性代謝疾病），死後病理才確認實為 MSA。單一個案報告，不能推論誤診發生率；收錄理由是它與前一日收錄的德文綜述指向同一個結構性限制：MSA 確診至今仍只能靠死後病理，而在非典型年齡層，MSA 可能完全不在臨床鑑別診斷的視野內。此類誤診方向對疾病修飾療法的意義在於，部分病人在仍可介入的早期階段從未被納入試驗族群。CT.gov 當日 MSA 查詢回傳的相關試驗（Teva TEV-56286 主試驗與延伸試驗、Lundbeck amlenetug MASCOT、Alterity ATH434 法國開放標籤延伸、MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 造影、Synusight SST001、AskBio 前置研究）全部已在平台紀錄內、狀態無變動；其餘回傳為 risdiplam、salanersen 等脊髓性肌肉萎縮症，以及肌少症、原發性纖毛不動症等「atrophy」字面誤中，逐筆確認適應症後排除。產業新聞掃描：Alterity ATH434 的 FDA End-of-Phase-2 註冊路徑（2026/07/07）與 Lundbeck MASCOT 完成隨機分派（2026/03/12 公告，較原訂提前）均為平台既已記錄的事實，本次未見近 7 天內的新事實。

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar: a clinicopathologic mismatch in young-onset parkinsonism, reported in Clinical Neuropathology — the patient was diagnosed during life with a neurotransmitter synthesis disorder, a class of largely treatable inherited metabolic conditions, and only post-mortem pathology established the disease was MSA. It is a single case report and says nothing about how often this happens; it is included because it points at the same structural limitation as the German-language review added the previous day: definitive diagnosis of MSA still requires autopsy, and in an atypical age group MSA may fall entirely outside the clinical differential. For disease-modifying therapy, a miss in this direction means some patients are never entered into the trial population while intervention is still possible. Every MSA-related trial returned by today's CT.gov query (Teva's TEV-56286 main and extension studies, Lundbeck's amlenetug MASCOT, Alterity's French open-label extension of ATH434, the MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 imaging study, Synusight's SST001 and the AskBio pre-gene-therapy study) was already on the platform with no change of status; the remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches — spinal muscular atrophy studies such as risdiplam and salanersen, plus sarcopenia and primary ciliary dyskinesia — excluded after checking the indication on each record. On the industry news side, Alterity's FDA End-of-Phase-2 registrational pathway for ATH434 (2026/07/07) and Lundbeck's completion of randomisation in MASCOT (announced 2026/03/12, ahead of plan) are both facts the platform already records; no new facts within the past 7 days were found.

body: 文獻雷達新增 1 篇：慕尼黑大學附設醫院團隊發表於 Fortschritte der Neurologie-Psychiatrie 的 MSA 綜述（德文、線上先行）。整理現行共識——MSA 為非典型帕金森症候群中罕見且進展快速者，臨床合併帕金森症狀、小腦性共濟失調與自律神經失調，病理核心為寡突膠細胞內錯誤摺疊 α-突觸核蛋白驅動的多系統退化；診斷依 MDS 準則並輔以 MRI，確診仍僅能靠死後病理；目前無疾病修飾療法，處置以症狀治療與多科照護為主。作者列出的研究優先方向為生物標記開發，以及針對 α-突觸核蛋白聚集與神經發炎的介入。本篇為綜述、不含新數據，收錄理由是可作為現行診斷準則的引用點，且其點出的「確診須待死後病理」正是本站追蹤中多項影像／體液生物標記研究（如 MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 造影試驗 NCT07640542）所要解決的問題。CT.gov 當日回傳的 MSA 相關試驗（Teva TEV-56286 兩項、Lundbeck amlenetug、Alterity ATH434 法國開放標籤延伸、MODAG 造影、AskBio 前置研究等）全部已在平台紀錄內、狀態無變動，無新增。其餘回傳為 risdiplam、salanersen 等脊髓性肌肉萎縮症與肌少症的「atrophy」字面誤中，逐筆確認後排除。產業新聞掃描（Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Teva TEV-56286、Ono ONO-2808、Tiziana foralumab、Ionis ION464）未見近 7 天內的新事實。

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar: a review of MSA from the Department of Neurology at LMU Klinikum, Munich, published in Fortschritte der Neurologie-Psychiatrie (in German, online ahead of print). It sets out the current consensus — MSA is a rare and rapidly progressive member of the atypical parkinsonian syndromes, presenting with parkinsonism, cerebellar ataxia and autonomic dysfunction, driven pathologically by misfolded α-synuclein in oligodendrocytes causing multisystem degeneration; diagnosis follows the MDS criteria supported by MRI, while definitive confirmation remains post-mortem only; and there are no disease-modifying treatments, so management is symptomatic and multidisciplinary. The authors name biomarker development and interventions against α-synuclein aggregation and neuroinflammation as research priorities. It is a review and contains no new data; it is included as a citable statement of the current criteria, and because the limitation it identifies — diagnosis confirmed only at autopsy — is exactly what several imaging and fluid-biomarker efforts tracked here are trying to solve, among them the MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 imaging study (NCT07640542). Every MSA-related trial returned by CT.gov today (two Teva TEV-56286 studies, Lundbeck's amlenetug, Alterity's French open-label extension of ATH434, the MODAG imaging study, the AskBio pre-gene-therapy study and others) was already on the platform with no change of status, so nothing was added. The remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches from spinal muscular atrophy and sarcopenia studies such as risdiplam and salanersen, excluded after checking each record. The industry news sweep (Alterity ATH434, Lundbeck amlenetug, Teva TEV-56286, Ono ONO-2808, Tiziana foralumab, Ionis ION464) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days.

body: ＊本次為 08/07–08/08 兩日合併掃描：08/07 排程未執行（該日無發布），已一併回補。文獻雷達新增 1 篇：東京都立神經病院發表於 Movement Disorders Clinical Practice 的回溯世代研究，分析 215 名 MSA 病人的無氣切存活期，平均存活 3.3 年（標準差 2.0）。多變量分析找出三個獨立危險因子：預後營養指數（PNI）偏低（HR 2.12，p = 0.018）、BMI 下降幅度較大（HR 2.90，p < 0.001）、UMSARS 第一部分第 2 項吞嚥分數較高（HR 1.59，p = 0.014）；作者結論為營養狀態惡化獨立於吞嚥困難嚴重度之外預測較短存活。此為回溯性觀察研究，證明的是相關與預測而非「補充營養可延長存活」；其領域意義在於 PNI 與 BMI 變化取自例行血液檢查與體重，取得成本遠低於影像或體液生物標記，可作為試驗分層與存活分析的候選共變數。CT.gov 兩日內的 MSA 相關更新有二：Teva TEV-56286（emrusolmin）Ph2 延伸試驗 NCT07197866 於 08/07 更新登錄，狀態仍為收案中、與平台既有紀錄一致，無需異動；另一筆為范德堡大學 midodrine 對照腹部加壓的自律神經衰竭心血管風險標記研究（NCT04620382）轉為「已完成」，屬症狀處置的機轉研究、非疾病修飾療法，依準則不予收錄。其餘為 risdiplam 等脊髓性肌肉萎縮症的「atrophy」字面誤中。產業新聞掃描（Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Teva TEV-56286、Ono ONO-2808、Tiziana foralumab、Ionis ION464）未見近 7 天內的新事實。

en.body: *This is a combined 07–08 August scan: the scheduled run did not execute on 07 August (nothing was published that day) and has been backfilled here. One paper added to the literature radar: a retrospective cohort study from Tokyo Metropolitan Neurological Hospital, published in Movement Disorders Clinical Practice, analysing tracheostomy-free survival in 215 patients with MSA, with mean survival of 3.3 years (SD 2.0). Multivariate analysis identified three independent risk factors: a lower prognostic nutritional index (PNI) (HR 2.12, p = 0.018), a greater decline in BMI (HR 2.90, p < 0.001) and a higher UMSARS Part I item 2 swallowing score (HR 1.59, p = 0.014), leading the authors to conclude that nutritional decline predicts shorter survival independently of the severity of dysphagia. This is a retrospective observational study and establishes association and prediction rather than showing that nutritional support extends survival; its field relevance is that PNI and BMI change come from routine bloods and body weight, far cheaper to obtain than imaging or fluid biomarkers, making them candidate covariates for stratification and survival analysis in trials. Two MSA-related CT.gov updates appeared across the two days: Teva's TEV-56286 (emrusolmin) Ph2 extension study NCT07197866 refreshed its record on 07 August, still recruiting and consistent with what the platform already holds, so no change was needed; and a Vanderbilt study of midodrine versus abdominal compression on cardiovascular risk markers in autonomic failure (NCT04620382) moved to "completed" — a mechanistic study of symptomatic management rather than a disease-modifying therapy, so not recorded. The remainder were literal 'atrophy' matches such as risdiplam in spinal muscular atrophy. The industry news sweep (Alterity ATH434, Lundbeck amlenetug, Teva TEV-56286, Ono ONO-2808, Tiziana foralumab, Ionis ION464) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days.

body: 文獻雷達新增 1 篇：四川大學華西醫院發表於 The Journals of Gerontology Series A 的兩年前瞻世代研究，收案 144 名早期 MSA 病人並依 MSA 專屬 MRI 標記分為影像陽性／陰性兩組，以 UMSARS 總分追蹤；影像陽性組在整體 MSA 與帕金森亞型的惡化速率顯著較快（p = 0.002、p = 0.020），校正年齡、性別與基線病程後於第 1、2 年皆為顯著預測因子。惟 144 人中僅 73 人完成兩年追蹤，且摘要未列出構成「影像陽性」的個別標記與閾值。CT.gov 當日更新中，MSA 相關者僅一筆美國 NINDS 慢性自律神經衰竭實驗室評估研究轉為「已完成」（觀察性研究，非療法，依準則不予收錄）；其餘為 risdiplam 等脊髓性肌肉萎縮症的「atrophy」字面誤中。產業新聞掃描（Alterity ATH434、Lundbeck amlenetug、Teva TEV-56286、Ono ONO-2808、Ionis ION464）未見近 7 天內的新事實。另本日將頁首「本週新增」KPI 依 git 紀錄逐筆核算為 6 筆，數字變動屬口徑校正。⚠️ 發布備註：本日內容推送後，GitHub Pages 連續兩次建置失敗（13:26、14:43 UTC，每次跑滿約 10 分鐘後逾時；對照 08/05 正常建置僅需 40 秒），姊妹站 SCA-IQ 同時段亦三次失敗，故本日更新上線時間延後。已查證全部資料檔編碼與 JSON 格式皆正常、GitHub 官方狀態頁顯示 Pages 服務正常，判斷為建置管線側問題而非內容錯誤。您能讀到本則即表示建置已恢復。

en.body: One paper added to the literature radar: a two-year prospective cohort study from West China Hospital, Sichuan University, published in The Journals of Gerontology Series A, which enrolled 144 patients with early MSA, split them into MRI-positive and MRI-negative groups on MSA-specific imaging markers and followed them on the UMSARS total score. The MRI-positive group progressed significantly faster, both for MSA overall and for the parkinsonian subtype (p = 0.002 and p = 0.020), and MRI-positive status remained a significant predictor at both the 1- and 2-year visits after adjustment for age, sex and baseline disease duration. Only 73 of the 144 patients completed two years of follow-up, however, and the abstract does not specify which individual markers and thresholds define "MRI-positive". Among today's CT.gov updates the sole MSA-related record was a US NINDS laboratory evaluation of chronic autonomic failure moving to "completed" — an observational study rather than a therapeutic, so not recorded — with the remainder literal 'atrophy' matches such as risdiplam in spinal muscular atrophy. The industry news sweep (Alterity ATH434, Lundbeck amlenetug, Teva TEV-56286, Ono ONO-2808, Ionis ION464) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days. The header "new this week" KPI was also recounted item by item from the git history today, giving 6; the change reflects the counting basis, not a change in activity. ⚠️ Publishing note: after today's content was pushed, the GitHub Pages build failed twice in a row (13:26 and 14:43 UTC, each running about 10 minutes before timing out, against 40 seconds for a normal build on 05 August), and the sister site SCA-IQ failed three times over the same period, so today's update went live later than usual. All data files were verified as valid UTF-8 and valid JSON and GitHub's own status page reported Pages as operational, pointing to the build pipeline rather than to any error in the content. If you can read this entry, the build has recovered.

body: ＊本次為 08/04–08/05 兩日合併掃描：08/04 排程未執行，已一併回補。臨床試驗雷達補收一筆：Synusight Biotech（上海）的 SST001 PET 造影劑第一期試驗（NCT07604116、收案中、2026/06/15 起始），n≈30 分健康受試者／MSA／帕金森氏症三組，評估安全性、耐受性、生物分佈、輻射劑量學與藥物動力學，站點在中國；此為造影工具而非治療藥物，與 MODAG [¹¹C]MODAG-005 同類收錄，惟公開登錄未載明標的分子，不予臆測。文獻雷達新增 2 篇：Magnetic Resonance Imaging 的定量磁化率造影（QSM）傘狀回顧指出殼核與蒼白球磁化率升高可有效區分 MSA、進行性核上性麻痺與原發性帕金森氏症；Frontiers in Immunology 以 149 人（PD 75、MSA-P 74）比較早期兩病的單核球發炎型態與紅血球 α-突觸核蛋白區室化差異（單中心、尚未獨立驗證，另有同期更正啟事）。CT.gov 兩日內其餘命中為脊髓性肌肉萎縮症（risdiplam）等「atrophy」字面誤中及自律神經衰竭觀察性研究，不予收錄。

en.body: *This is a combined 04–05 August scan: the scheduled run did not execute on 04 August and has been backfilled here. One entry added to the trial radar: Synusight Biotech's (Shanghai) Phase 1 study of the PET imaging agent SST001 (NCT07604116, recruiting, started 2026/06/15), n≈30 across healthy volunteers, MSA and Parkinson's disease, assessing safety, tolerability, biodistribution, radiation dosimetry and pharmacokinetics at sites in China. This is an imaging tool rather than a therapeutic, recorded on the same basis as MODAG's [¹¹C]MODAG-005; the public registration does not state the molecular target, and none is inferred here. Two papers added to the literature radar: an umbrella review in Magnetic Resonance Imaging finding that elevated quantitative susceptibility in the putamen and globus pallidus effectively separates MSA and progressive supranuclear palsy from idiopathic Parkinson's disease; and a study in Frontiers in Immunology comparing monocyte inflammatory profiles and erythrocyte alpha-synuclein compartmentalisation across 149 participants (75 PD, 74 MSA-P) in early disease (single-centre, not independently replicated, with a correction notice also published). The remaining CT.gov hits across the two days were literal 'atrophy' matches such as spinal muscular atrophy (risdiplam) plus an observational autonomic-failure study, and were not recorded.

body: 臨床試驗雷達補收一筆：MODAG 的 [¹¹C]MODAG-005 α-synuclein PET 放射配體先導試驗（NCT07640542、Early Ph1、收案中）。此案昨日已在領域焦點提及，但試驗雷達本身尚未建檔，今日補齊：n≈9，收 PD、MSA 病人與年齡配對健康對照，病人做兩次掃描、主要指標為注射後 4 天內安全性與耐受性並評估再測再現性，部分受試者在第二次掃描前口服 300 mg anle138b（emrusolmin）；單一站點為德國圖賓根大學醫院。此為造影／生物標記工具而非治療藥物，因 MSA 長期缺乏活體 α-synuclein 定量手段而收錄。CT.gov 近 7 天其餘命中為脊髓性肌肉萎縮症（salanersen）等「atrophy」字面誤中，不予收錄；PubMed 近 7 天 4 篇 MSA 標題文獻均已在文獻雷達內。

en.body: One entry added to the trial radar: MODAG's [¹¹C]MODAG-005 α-synuclein PET radioligand pilot (NCT07640542, Early Ph1, recruiting). The study was mentioned in yesterday's field focus but had no record on the trial radar itself, so it is filled in today: n≈9 across PD patients, MSA patients and age-matched healthy controls, with two scans for patients, safety and tolerability through 4 days post-injection as the primary endpoints alongside test-retest characteristics, and a subset receiving 300 mg oral anle138b (emrusolmin) before the second scan; the single site is Universitätsklinikum Tübingen in Germany. This is an imaging and biomarker tool rather than a therapeutic, recorded because MSA has long lacked a way to quantify α-synuclein in living patients. The remaining CT.gov hits from the past 7 days were literal 'atrophy' matches such as spinal muscular atrophy (salanersen) and were not recorded; all four MSA-titled PubMed papers from the past week were already on the literature radar.

body: 更新 α-synuclein PET 示蹤劑那則領域焦點：MODAG 的 [¹¹C]MODAG-005 再測信度先導研究已於 2026/07/29 啟動收案（NCT07640542，n=9、德國圖賓根大學醫院單中心，主要完成估 2027/07），原紀錄為「尚未收案」；同時依登錄資料校正 Synusight SST001 的起始日為 2026/06/15（原記為 2026/05）並補上站點與收案數。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 掃描未見新的在研療法（其餘命中為 SMA／DMD／原發性纖毛不動症等「atrophy」字面誤中）；PubMed 近 7 天 4 篇 MSA 標題文獻均已在文獻雷達內。

en.body: Updated the α-synuclein PET tracer field-focus entry: MODAG's [¹¹C]MODAG-005 test-retest pilot opened to recruitment on 29 July 2026 (NCT07640542, n=9, single site at Tübingen University Hospital in Germany, primary completion estimated 2027/07), where the record previously read 'not yet recruiting'. The start date for Synusight's SST001 was corrected to 15 June 2026 from 2026/05 per the registry, with sites and enrolment added. The 7-day CT.gov sweep found no new MSA therapies in development — the remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches such as SMA, DMD and primary ciliary dyskinesia — and all four MSA-titled PubMed papers from the past week were already on the literature radar.

body: 新增 1 則文獻：英國 ExPRESS 新發帕金森症候群前瞻世代研究計畫書（BMJ Open，UCL／劍橋／布里斯托／牛津，n=500，其中 120 人做深度生物標記）——文中指出 MSA 自症狀發生到診斷中位數 3.1 年、遠長於帕金森氏症的 1.0–1.2 年，該世代的目標之一即建立可供疾病修飾治療試驗使用的 trial-ready 族群。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 掃描未見新的在研療法（Alterity ATH434-203 延伸試驗與 Teva TEV-56286 延伸試驗均已在列且狀態無變更；其餘命中為 SMA／原發性纖毛不動症等「atrophy」字面誤中）。Alterity 2026/07/30 之 Q4 FY26 季報僅重述 7 月已收錄的 FDA End-of-Phase-2 樞紐設計，無新事實，故不另收。

en.body: Added one paper: the protocol for ExPRESS, a UK prospective cohort of incident parkinsonism (BMJ Open; UCL / Cambridge / Bristol / Oxford; n=500, with 120 undergoing deep biomarker assessment). It notes a median 3.1 years from symptom onset to diagnosis in MSA against 1.0–1.2 years in Parkinson's disease, and one of the cohort's aims is to build a trial-ready population for disease-modifying treatment studies. The 7-day CT.gov sweep found no new MSA therapies in development: Alterity's ATH434-203 extension and Teva's TEV-56286 extension are both already listed with unchanged status, and the remaining hits were literal 'atrophy' matches such as SMA and primary ciliary dyskinesia. Alterity's Q4 FY26 quarterly report of 2026/07/30 only restates the FDA End-of-Phase-2 pivotal design already captured in July, so it was not recorded again.

body: 在研療法全景新增 Denali Therapeutics DNL422（OTV:SNCA）——以 TransportVehicle 平台穿越血腦障壁、直接靶向 α-synuclein，仍在 IND-enabling 階段、主打帕金森病；與 MSA 的關聯是機轉相鄰而非直接競爭（MSA 病灶在寡突膠細胞、帕金森在神經元）。另於總覽新增姊妹站連結：MSA 相關的細胞治療與 CDMO 生態系對象統一收錄於 SCA-IQ 的「合作機會」頁。

link.label: 詳見 在研療法全景 ↗

en.body: Added Denali Therapeutics' DNL422 (OTV:SNCA) to the therapy landscape — crossing the blood-brain barrier on the TransportVehicle platform and targeting alpha-synuclein directly, still IND-enabling and aimed at Parkinson's disease; its link to MSA is mechanistic adjacency rather than direct competition, since MSA pathology sits in oligodendrocytes and Parkinson's in neurons. A sister-site link was also added to the Overview: MSA-relevant cell therapy and CDMO counterparties are consolidated on SCA-IQ's Partnering tab.

body: 新增 1 則文獻：2022 MDS 診斷準則之姿勢性低血壓條件驗證（Eur Neurol，日本，n=451）——MDS 準則使 MSA 的姿勢性低血壓偵測率由 39.3% 升至 64.5%，但在帕金森病、路易體失智與純自主神經衰竭同樣大量命中；收縮壓過衝在 MSA 僅 6.5%，可能是鑑別線索。另新增 1 則領域焦點：盤點以 MSA 為目標族群的 α-synuclein PET 造影示蹤劑（MODAG [¹⁸F]MODAG-009／[¹¹C]MODAG-005、Synusight SST001）——屬造影示蹤劑非治療藥物，依準則不列入試驗雷達。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 掃描未見在研療法新進者（其餘命中為 SMA／DMD／肌少症等「atrophy」字面誤中）。

en.body: Added 1 paper: a validation of the orthostatic-hypotension component of the 2022 MDS diagnostic criteria (Eur Neurol, Japan, n=451) — the MDS criteria raise detection of orthostatic hypotension in MSA from 39.3% to 64.5% but also flag large fractions of Parkinson's disease, dementia with Lewy bodies and pure autonomic failure, while systolic overshoot occurs in only 6.5% of MSA and may serve as a differentiating clue. Also added one field item: a stocktake of α-synuclein PET tracers that include MSA as a target population (MODAG's [¹⁸F]MODAG-009 and [¹¹C]MODAG-005, Synusight's SST001) — these are imaging tracers rather than treatments, so per the inclusion rule they are not listed on the trial radar. The last 7 days of CT.gov MSA screening found no new investigational therapies; the remaining hits were literal false matches on "atrophy" from SMA, DMD and sarcopenia studies.

body: 新增 1 筆試驗：Alterity ATH434 開放標籤延伸試驗 ATH434-203（NCT07729852，2026/07 登錄）——僅供已完成 ATH434-201 的法國病人續用，收案上限 5 人、不新招募，75 mg 每日兩次口服，初期 12 個月，主要指標為安全性與耐受性，站點為土魯斯、波爾多、馬賽、巴黎。PubMed 近 7 天無未收錄之 MSA 標題論文（唯一新命中為 PSP／PD／MSA 鑑別影像的期刊評論，無摘要、暫不收錄）。

en.body: Added 1 trial: Alterity's open-label extension ATH434-203 (NCT07729852, registered 2026/07) — continued access for French patients who completed ATH434-201 only, capped at 5 participants with no new recruitment, 75 mg orally twice daily for an initial 12 months, with safety and tolerability as the primary endpoints, at sites in Toulouse, Bordeaux, Marseille and Paris. PubMed showed no unrecorded MSA-titled papers in the last 7 days (the one new hit was a journal editorial on differentiating PSP, PD and MSA by imaging, with no abstract, so it was not added).

body: 新增 1 則文獻：小腦萎縮經由認知功能影響 MSA 步態凍結（CNS Neurosci Ther，武漢大學人民醫院，n=106）——Crus II 萎縮可獨立預測 N-FOGQ 分數，執行功能與注意力缺損為中介因子。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 適應症逐筆確認後無新療法試驗或狀態變更。

en.body: Added 1 paper: cerebellar atrophy influences freezing of gait in MSA through cognitive dysfunction (CNS Neurosci Ther, Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University, n=106) — Crus II atrophy independently predicted N-FOGQ scores, mediated by executive-function and attention deficits. A study-by-study check of the last 7 days on CT.gov found no new MSA therapy trials or status changes.

body: 新增 2 則文獻：UK Biobank 巢式病例對照研究（Mov Disord，114 例新發 MSA；居住鄉村為唯一隨潛伏期增強的暴露，5 年窗 OR 2.73）與因斯布魯克團隊領域綜論（J Neural Transm，指出 α-synuclein 標的治療迄今未展現一致臨床效益）。更新 Alterity ATH434 一列：2026/07/07 FDA End-of-Phase-2 會議紀錄確認註冊路徑（Ph3 約 200 人、主要終點 11 項 UMSARS Part I、單一樞紐試驗＋確認性證據），並加入領域焦點一則。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 適應症逐筆確認後無新療法試驗（其餘命中為肌少症、PSP 遠距監測等非 MSA 療法研究）。

en.body: Added 2 papers: a UK Biobank nested case-control study (Mov Disord; 114 incident MSA cases, with rural living the only exposure that strengthened with latency, 5-year OR 2.73) and a field review from the Innsbruck group (J Neural Transm, noting that α-synuclein-targeted therapies have not yet shown consistent clinical benefit). Updated the Alterity ATH434 row: FDA End-of-Phase-2 meeting minutes announced 2026/07/07 confirmed the registrational pathway (Ph3 of ~200 patients, 11-item UMSARS Part I primary endpoint, single pivotal trial plus confirmatory evidence), and added a matching field-focus item. A study-by-study check of the last 7 days on CT.gov found no new MSA therapy trials (other hits were sarcopenia, PSP remote monitoring and similar non-MSA studies).

body: 新增 1 篇文獻（Cell：TPPP/p25 類澱粉種子活性作為 MSA 專一性生物標記）。CT.gov 掃描未見在研療法新進者——新登錄的 Synusight SST001（NCT07604116）為 PET 造影示蹤劑、非治療藥物，依準則不收錄。

en.body: Added 1 paper (Cell: TPPP/p25 amyloid seeding activity as a specific biomarker for MSA). The CT.gov sweep surfaced no new investigational therapy — the newly registered Synusight SST001 (NCT07604116) is a PET imaging tracer, not a therapeutic, and is excluded per the inclusion criteria.

body: 新增 2 篇文獻（QSM 黑質磁化率／體積比之 PSP/PD/MSA 鑑別、MSA 不隨意吸氣性歎息與腦血流研究）。

en.body: Added 2 papers (QSM substantia-nigra susceptibility-to-volume ratio for PSP/PD/MSA discrimination, and involuntary inspiratory sighing with cerebral blood flow in MSA).

body: MSA-IQ 情報站上線：收錄 11 個在研療法／學術案、8 個臨床試驗、9 筆試驗讀出、4 項評估量表、3 個自然史世代、3 則機轉與臨床前重點、9 篇近期文獻，全部附可查證來源、中英雙語。

en.body: MSA-IQ went live: 11 therapies and academic programmes, 8 clinical trials, 9 trial readouts, 4 rating scales, 3 natural-history cohorts, 3 mechanism/preclinical topics and 9 recent papers — every entry sourced, in both Chinese and English.
